description: cupertino: enforces MUST-NOT rules (ordering gates, one-item-per-dispatch, write-scope, persisted-state schema, no-commit-during-audit) and, during a cupertino-repair run, scopes every source edit to the active approved item and routes deletes through a reversible script at the tool-call layer, regardless of whether a skill is followed. Inert until a repo has a .cupertino/ state directory.
